text:
Believe me when I say gettin' older ain't easy.
Slaying a few of these creatures was a lot less stressful back then.
zh:
信我这句话，上了年纪可不容易。
想当年，宰几只这种怪物哪有这么费劲。

text:
Anyway, I need some time to catch my breath.
You'll find me back in my hut near the swamp.
zh:
总之，我得喘口气歇一歇。
回头到沼泽边我的小屋来找我吧。

text: Yo, what are you doin' here in the Rhoga swamp?
zh: 喂，你跑来罗加沼泽干什么？

text:
A brutal beast is lurkin' 'round.
Better go back to wherever ya came from.
zh:
有头凶残的野兽在这一带潜伏。
你最好从哪儿来回哪儿去。
